scrapers.description: Asian drama, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Repo-wide TMDB alias matching V1: canonical/original/alternative/translated titles, with season-aware alias queries and alias-aware candidate scoring.

scrapers.name: OneTouchTV
scrapers.description: Asian drama, anime, series and movie streams with subtitle metadata
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Repo-wide TMDB alias matching V1: alternative/translated TMDB aliases feed title search, detail scoring and season-aware queries.

scrapers.name: HDHub4u
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Hotfix: fixes recursive fetchWithTimeout wrapper that caused QuickJS stack overflow and could freeze VUEO. Keeps repo-wide TMDB alias matching and bounded extraction.

scrapers.name: MovieBox
scrapers.description: Movie and TV streams from the current MovieBox H5 web API mirror pool
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Repo-wide TMDB alias matching V1. MovieBox now scores canonical, original, alternative and translated TMDB titles. Alias H5 fallback is bounded to two mirrors, and WebView fallback is reduced to ~5.2s so an H5 title miss no longer consumes the full 20s provider budget.

scrapers.name: 4KHDHub
scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Repo-wide TMDB alias matching V1: canonical/original/alternative/translated titles are searched and scored with year/media-type checks.

scrapers.name: PencuriMovie

scrapers.author: Luckez
scrapers.notes: Repo-wide TMDB alias matching V1: aliases are used for direct slugs, site search and candidate scoring; searches stop once a strong match is found.

scrapers.name: MSM21

scrapers.author: Luckez
